title: The Book on the Taboo Against Knowing Who You Are

title: Existentialism is a Humanism

title: Letters from a Stoic

title: The Analects

title: The Dhammapada

description: The quintessential collection of the Buddha's sayings. A concise, powerful guide to training the mind for clarity, peace, and awakening.

title: The Tibetan Book of the Dead

title: The Black Swan

title: Essentialism
author: Greg McKeown
description: The disciplined pursuit of less. A strategy for discerning what is absolutely vital and eliminating everything else to make a higher contribution.

title: The Psychology of Money

description: Timeless lessons on wealth, greed, and happiness. Housel reveals that managing money is less about what you know and more about how you behave.

title: 12 Rules for Life

title: The Denial of Death

title: The Structure of Scientific Revolutions

title: The Master and His Emissary

title: The Wisdom of Insecurity
